Hi Chloe / Rishi,

We started seeing a sharp uptick in p99 response latency on your hosted streaming chat (SSE) around 18:00 PT during our evening peak. Error rates also rose briefly; customers experienced stalled messages and retries. This started at ~17:58 and peaked at ~18:03 before some clients began reconnecting.

Quick facts:
- Region: us-west-2
- Affected users: ~3% of live sessions, concentrated on a single shard
- Symptoms: p95 up ~250ms, p99 up to 3.8s, intermittent 502s on open stream writes

I attached a small trace and a dashboard snapshot. We are in a live campaign tonight so this is high impact — asking for help and a fast mitigation plan.

Attaching: ember-sample-trace.json, sre-dashboard-snapshot.png

Can you confirm if anything changed on your side (deploys, routing changes, config) around 17:45–18:10 PT?

Subject: Fwd: live chat p99 spike — initial triage and mitigation

Chloe / Rishi — quick triage notes and what we did to mitigate (timeline below). Forwarding initial findings to keep the thread intact.

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 02:52 PM Redwood SRE <sre-automations@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Observed a short-lived compaction-induced KV cache eviction across a hot shard in us-west-2 at 17:59 PT. This caused increased backend fetch latency for new tokens and amplified tail latency under heavy concurrent streaming writes.
>
> Mitigations applied at 18:05 PT:
>  - Bumped cache window for affected shard to 45m (from 10m)
>  - Increased streaming write workers by +20% for the shard (hot patch)
>  - Applied temporary routing to route Ember traffic to a sibling pool to spread load
>
> Post-mitigations: p99 dropped from ~3.8s to ~680ms within 3 minutes and errors subsided.

Actions for next 48h (recommended):
- Root cause RCA: KV compaction schedule intersected with the marketing traffic pattern; need compaction smoothing and shard-aware scheduling.
- Consider a per-account hot-cache pin option for high-volume customers during campaigns.
- SRE to open JIRA INF-9876 for follow-up and permanent fixes.

I'll add logs + sampling traces into the JIRA ticket. Marco — please confirm if the mitigation restored customer experience on your end.

—
Rachel Kim
SRE Lead, Serving Platform | Redwood Inference
